line: Crowley on Atu VIII: Justice renamed, Libra under Venus, the letters Aleph Lamed, and the exactness of Nature (pdf p76, p77).

sections.title: Justice and Libra
sections.line: Crowley on the old name Justice, on Libra, ruled by Venus, with Saturn exalted, and on the equilibrium of all things (pdf p76).

quotes.quote: This card in the old pack was called Justice.
This card represents the sign of Libra, ruled by Venus; in it Saturn is exalted.
The equilibrium of all things is hereby symbolized.

sections.title: Aleph Lamed, the Fool and Nature
sections.line: Crowley on the letters Aleph Lamed, the feminine complement of the Fool, and Nature as exact and scrupulously just (pdf p76, p77).

quotes.quote: the letters Aleph Lamed constitute the secret key of the Book of the Law
this card is the feminine complement of the Fool
Nature is not just, according to any theological or ethical idea; but Nature is exact.
In this sense, Nature is scrupulously just.
